====Christmas (from Harriet)====
'''''Posted by Harriet on December 23rd, 2006 in the Robert Jordan's Blog category'''''


Dear Jason, something to post, to celebrate the season — and Jim’s WONDERFUL news. Love to you all, Harriet


: A Genuine Wham-O

:
: Lists for cards, lists for cookies,<br />lists for books and scarves and games<br />and candles. Maybe<br />a bell would fit in there.<br />Maybe I’ll give it up and be a witch.

: My ersatz Frisbees –<br />cards and scarves –<br />are packed with love,<br />but never seem to hit the mark,<br />the tender lips, the gleaming fangs<br />of those I throw them to.<br />I’ll borrow a young terrier bitch<br />and lob a real one for her.

: Frisbees of love? We live in one:<br />the Milky Way. Or are you going<br />to fob me off with dusty physics,<br />lumps of coal and willow switches?<br />Please! The world sends me huge bright disks<br />of love and light.<br />Although it’s hard to see them, hidden as they are<br />in books and scarves and games<br />and candles. And a bell.



– Harriet Popham Rigney
